lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular centroids arranged in roughly vertical columns. A prominent triad of spots is visible in a vertical alignment posterior to the pectoral fin junction, centered in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the primary spot centroids to create a regular, grid-like matrix across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal carinae are visible on the upper flank, characterized by linear regions of high luminance on the superior edge transitioning to a shadow-defined gradient on the inferior edge.
